newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia allows off-exchange T-bill trade.
newsitem.headline: Russia allows off-exchange T-bill trade.

text.p: Russia's central bank will allow banks to trade government securities with their clients off-exchange from June 30, the bank said on Thursday.
Currently trading only takes place on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), and selected regional exchanges linked to it, between 0700 GMT and 0900 GMT, on weekdays except Wednesday.
Off-exchange deals will be registered between 0730 GMT and 0930 GMT, the bank said in a statement.

Deals at prices within the spreads on the issue will be registered between 0730 GMT and 0900 GMT, and deals at the average price of the previous trading session will be registered between 0900 GMT and 0930 GMT, it said.
